name: Credit-spread stress GATE arms defensive sector-ETF rotation (HY OAS + macro risk-off)
rationale: THESIS: HY credit_spread (ICE BofA HY OAS, +IC already flagged in our cross-asset scan) is equity's most-watched anxiety meter and leads equity vol. The ORTHOGONAL trade is not 'spreads wide => sell stocks' (a tired index-timing level trade) but a defensive/cyclical ROTATION: when HY OAS widens past a credit-stress level, investment-grade, cycle-insensitive defensive sectors (XLU/XLP/XLV) outperform cyclicals on a RELATIVE basis even when the index is flat. Hedge funds express this as a leveraged long/short sector pair; a long-only daily bot can only own the LONG defensive leg when the credit gate is armed, ranked by ret_Nd to hold the best-trending defensive sibling. That is a lower-capacity, lower-Sharpe slice the funds ignore. LOW-TURNOVER by construction: HY OAS regime crossings are infrequent, and credit_spread is BOUNDED so a fitted stress level genuinely binds. DISCONFIRMERS (authored as sibling controls in the cohort, must beat BOTH net of fees): (1) Always-defensive control = own XLU/XLP/XLV unconditionally with no credit gate; if it matches this gated spec, the credit regime adds nothing and we are merely long low-beta. (2) Spread-as-trend control = replace this BOUNDED level gate with a cross_up of credit_spread momentum; if the level gate does not beat the momentum gate, the 'regime' is just spread trend in disguise. macro_regime risk-off confirm (tanh composite, negative = risk-off) suppresses isolated single-asset spread blips that are not real cross-asset stress. The Gate disposes; an honest FAIL (defensives during stress = buy-the-low-beta-dip) is a valid outcome.
catalyst: HY OAS credit_spread widens into a fitted stress band while macro_regime confirms cross-asset risk-off
